entries.message: Feature - Complete watch sync and media detail workflows
entries.author: Lasikiewicz
details: Add configurable app-marked watch policies with a manual review queue, show grouping, bulk decisions, and custom watch dates
Keep Plex, Emby, Jellyfin, and Plembfin watched/unwatched state synchronized with reliable now-playing and Up Next refreshes
Restore complete TV show metadata and canonical show navigation from dashboard and history
Improve TV and movie detail loading, episode layouts, artwork handling, and incremental live updates
Add onboarding and Settings controls for sync tuning, watch thresholds, and fast local-network sync
Harden large-library history, caching, sync retries, and provider identity matching with regression coverage
